title: Relies on experimental node:sqlite module
evidence: src/db.ts:1 imports DatabaseSync from node:sqlite; README.md:8 notes Node 24+ required

title: PUT requires a full valid body (no partial update)
evidence: src/app.ts:70 PUT calls validateBookInput which requires title+author
suggestion: Spec asks only to 'update a book'; full-replace PUT semantics are correct. Partial PATCH would be a beyond-spec enhancement.
